qualification: scoped direct conductor read from two different crops/resolutions of the .11 page-4 scan; winding sections, turns and manual connection 16 remain unresolved
reading: A vertical thin conductor begins at the junction dot on the X1:1 horizontal lead and ends at the junction dot on the X1:7 horizontal lead. It crosses the X1:2, X1:3 and X1:5 leads without junction dots. The pair is an external same-node tie in the page-4 T3 symbol; those crossed leads are not tied by this conductor.
effect_on_model: The opt-in 20-port KiCad wrapper currently exports X1:1 and X1:7 on separate nets and therefore misses this source-visible conductor. Its assumed single ordered high-voltage group also needs splitting or re-evaluation before any corrected connected simulation is qualified.
unresolved: The thick winding bars and the identity of the manual's connection 16 need a separate source-bounded magnetic section map.
The conductor fixes an external node equality, not section turns, polarity, loading or the HV differential cold end.
